t: An automatic vanilla brewer.$(br2)When supplied with $(6)Power$() it will create a potion from the provided ingredients.$(br)Empty bottles will be filled if the internal $(6)water$() container is filled and it won't get consumed. $(br2)A potion needs to be configured in the green filter to be able to extract any potions.
一台自动原版酿造台。$(br2)当为其提供$(6)能量$()时，它会利用所提供的材料酿造药水。$(br)若内部$(6)水$()容器已装满，则空玻璃瓶将被自动灌装，且水不会被消耗。$(br2)需在绿色过滤器中配置一种药水，才能提取对应药水。
